user.title: Pebble Home
user.description: Choose what your Pebble can see and do. The guesses come from your house.

data_description.alarm_entity: Shown on the face; arm and disarm from the watch.
data_description.doorbell_entities: Entities that turn on (or event entities that fire) when someone presses the bell.
data_description.cameras: Cameras you can browse on the watch.
data_description.perimeter: The face shows a count of these that are open.
data_description.status_entities: Up to six extra values on the status screen.
data_description.quick_actions: Scripts, scenes and switches you can fire from the watch.
data_description.assist_agent: Conversation agent for voice commands from the watch microphone.
data_description.frigate_vibrate: Events are always logged; this decides when the watch buzzes.
data_description.alarm_code: Only if your panel needs a code. Stored in Home Assistant, never sent to the phone.
data_description.watch_pin: Digits you enter on the watch to unlock doors. Optional. If set, the watch asks for it to disarm or unlock, and Home Assistant checks it. You can also set one in the Pebble app's Home settings.
data_description.media_players: Sonos and other players you can control from the watch.
data_description.exit_delay: How long your panel counts down when arming. Shown as a countdown on the watch.
data_description.entry_delay: How long the panel waits after a door opens before the siren.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pebble Home is already set up.

init.title: Pebble Home
init.description:
Watch key: `{key}`

Watch apps: open [{store}]({store}) on your phone and tap **Add to the Pebble app**. They then update with this integration.
